content.comment_body: Hello, I have an issue with the [product_name] operating at 230V with article number [article_no]. When I download the program from my PC to the device, the display shows success, but the program is not stored inside. Uploading from the device works fine; however, downloading from PC does not work. I have an older program on a yellow memory card; when I insert the card and download the program into the device, it stores correctly and works as expected. What could be the problem? Why does upload work, but downloading from PC fails while the yellow card succeeds? Thank you for any advice. [user_name]
Dear [user_name], Are you using [product_name] with article number [article_no] and a yellow memory card? Please see this FAQ: [url] Best regards, [user_name]

Hello, thank you for responding to my question. I’ll clarify the issue with my [product_name] (article no. [article_no], type RCL 230V). I’ve checked compatibility including the yellow card and related components. Downloading from PC to the device doesn't work. How should I check the cable connection? Any suggestions? When downloading from PC, the screen shows success, but the program isn’t present in the device memory, so it's not functioning. As I mentioned before, if I use the yellow card to transfer the program, everything works perfectly and the program loads into memory. The issue only occurs when transferring from PC to the device. Uploading from the device to PC works fine, and when I set the clock using the cable, it all functions properly. Thanks again for your help! [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing problems when attempting to download a program from a PC to the [product_name] device; the process reports success, but the program is not saved in memory and the device does not operate correctly. Conversely, transferring the program from a yellow memory card to the device works consistently, revealing inconsistencies between download methods. Uploads from the device to PC and card-to-device downloads function properly, but direct PC-to-device downloads fail.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the download from PC to [product_name] devices to reliably transfer and store programs in memory, with successful messages accurately reflecting system status, just as the yellow card method does.
